title: Ada Twist and the strange smell.
lines: She has black curls and big glasses.
A scientist is someone who asks lots and lots of questions.
Rosie wants to build things when she grows up.
And Iggy wants to draw houses when he grows up.
He always has a pencil with him.
One morning Ada comes into the kitchen.
What smells so bad in here?
It smells like old cheese and wet socks at the same time.
Even the cat pulls a funny face.
This is a mystery, she says.
Rosie and Iggy come to help.
Ada explains how a scientist works.
Our question is: where is that smell coming from?
Then you think of an idea.
You check whether your idea is right.
The bin has just been emptied.
They go and look in the laundry basket.
She taps her pencil on her head.
The closer we get to the smell, the worse it will be.
In the living room it smells a little.
In the hall it smells more.
By the stairs it smells even more.
Upstairs, by her brother Arthur's room, it smells the most of all!
And a banana, all brown and soft.
They've been in there for a week!
Why does food actually start to smell?
Tiny little creatures grow on food.
They're so small that you can't see them.
After a while those creatures eat the bread and the banana.
And then it starts to smell.
That's why we put food in the fridge.
In the cold the creatures grow very slowly.
One question always leads to a new question.
The yucky sandwich goes in the bin.
The banana goes in the compost bin.
That evening they eat a fresh sandwich together.
Arthur says: From now on I'll empty my bag every day.
Ada is lying in bed thinking.
And tomorrow she'll solve another one.
